reference_soap.assessment: Clinical presentation highly suggestive of Decubitus Ulcer Sacral Myocutaneous Flap.
reference_soap.plan: Urgently assess for sepsis or spreading infection; obtain appropriate deep tissue or bone cultures when debridement is performed and use antibiotics guided by clinical findings and culture results. Maintain strict pressure off-loading, continence care, and nutritional optimization. Flap reconstruction should be planned by the specialist team only after the wound bed, infection control, and caregiver repositioning plan are adequate.
